Ford.note: American brand whose European range is mostly European-built: Transit/Transit Custom by Ford Otosan (TR), Puma and Courier in Craiova (RO), Explorer/Capri in Cologne (DE), Kuga in Valencia (ES), Connect by VW in Poznań (PL); Ranger from Silverton (ZA), Mustang/Bronco from the US, Mach-E from Mexico, Transit City from JMC (CN) – no single foreign country.

Cadillac.hq_entity: Cadillac Motor Car Division of General Motors
Cadillac.note: Lyriq and Vistiq are built in Spring Hill (US); the Optiq is built in Wuhan (CN, SAIC-GM) and Ramos Arizpe (MX), but Wikipedia does not say which plant supplies Europe.

Chevrolet.note: Only the Corvette is sold in Europe; it is built in Bowling Green, Kentucky.

Tesla.note: American brand with no US-built cars in Europe: the Model Y comes mainly from Gigafactory Berlin in Grünheide (DE), the Model 3 from Gigafactory Shanghai (CN) – two foreign countries, so no second flag.
